description: This PHP class 'EmployeeDirectoryModel' represents a data model for employee directory entries within the OrangeHRM system. It defines how employee attributes are serialized and exposed via the API, including properties like employee number, name, termination ID, job title, subunit, and location. The class constructs itself based on an Employee entity and specifies which attributes and relations should be included in the serialized output.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing employee directory information in the OrangeHRM API. Implements normalization and serialization traits to expose employee details such as name, job title, subunit, and location.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
